Definition: from G4253 and G1325; to give before the other party has given:--first give.
BiblicalUsage: Prodidomi means to give first, to give before the other party has given. Paul asks it once, in the doxology of Romans: who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the answer is no one, and that is the whole gospel: God always gives first.
